title: New Smoke Rules & Urban Growth
summary:
*   A public hearing was set to discuss new guidelines for an anti-smoking ordinance.
*   An acting clerk was officially appointed for the Municipal Court.
*   Council reviewed reports on city services for newly annexed areas, Loop 360 development, and specific zoning activities.
*   A work session focused on septic tank regulations and associated capital recovery fees.

CITY MANAGER REPORTS
There was a report scheduled to be given on Anti-Smoking Ordinance Guidelines. Mayor
Cooksey and the Council agreed to set a public hearing on the subject for 6:30 p.m. on
March 20, 1986.
A report on Service to Newly Annexed Areas was given by Jim Thompson, Director of Water
and Wastewater.
Jim Duncan, Director of OLDS reported on Zoning Activity in the Manchaca - I.H. 35 Area.
Mr. Duncan also discussed Loop 360 Corridor Regional Service Plan.
A report on Advance Refunding Process was also presented to Councilmembers.
The report on City of Austin Budget History was postponed for one week.
WORK SESSION
Council held a work session on Septic Tank Outcover-Capital Recovery Fee.
